items.title: Small Steps Big Year 2027 Footprints
items.alt: Three colored shoe prints climb toward a gold star marked 2027 above green Small Steps Big Year lettering.
items.description: Brown, blue and pink soles show different tread patterns along a curling green trail that links the message to the year.

items.title: Grateful for 2027 Flower Basket
items.alt: A woven basket holds a sunflower, white daisies and a pink lily behind a Grateful For ribbon and blue 2027 tag.
items.description: The arched basket handle and broad green leaves frame the mixed flowers, with the cream ribbon curving across the wicker front.

items.title: Kindness in 2027 Bird Pair
items.alt: A blue bird and a pink bird hold a red heart reading Kindness in 2027.
items.description: The birds’ open smiles, rounded wings and yellow feet flank the gold-edged heart; a red flower bow distinguishes the pink bird.

items.title: Dreams Take Flight 2027 Paper Airplane
items.alt: A white paper airplane flies over navy 2027 numerals and a cream Dreams Take Flight ribbon with a curling gold trail.
items.description: A loose gold orbit and small stars carry the eye around the large beveled year beneath the departing paper plane.

items.title: Bold Beginnings 2027 Paintbrush
items.alt: Cream Bold Beginnings lettering and gold 2027 numerals sit inside a blue and gold paint sweep above a broad brush.
items.description: Thick curved paint strokes form an open oval around the message, ending near the brush’s dark blue bristles and brown handle.

items.title: Bloom in 2027 Floral Watering Can
items.alt: A teal watering can marked 2027 holds a pink tulip, yellow sunflower and white daisy beneath Bloom In lettering.
items.description: Gold edging, small painted flowers and pink hearts decorate the can, whose long spout and curved handle remain fully visible.
